Title: Oobit
Description: Tap & Pay crypto card backed by Tether
Full description: Oobit is the crypto version of Apple Pay. You tap your phone, the app converts your USDT, BTC or ETH into local currency in real time, and the merchant gets paid instantly
Cos'è:
Oobit is the crypto version of Apple Pay. You tap your phone, the app converts your USDT, BTC or ETH into local currency in real time, and the merchant gets paid instantly — no preloading, no manual sell orders, no waiting. Backed by Tether (the company behind the world's most used stablecoin), it runs on Visa rails at 150M+ merchants across 150+ countries.

The DePay layer goes one step further: instead of depositing into Oobit, you connect your own MetaMask or Trust Wallet and spend directly from it. Funds stay self-custodied until the nanosecond of payment. For users who want crypto-native payments without giving up wallet control, this is the closest existing solution.
Come funziona:
1. Download the Oobit app (iOS or Android) and complete KYC onboarding.

  2. Fund your Oobit wallet by depositing USDT, BTC, ETH or other supported assets, OR connect an external wallet (MetaMask, Trust Wallet, etc.) via DePay to spend without preloading.

  3. Activate your virtual Visa card — no physical card is available.

  4. Pay in-store via Tap & Pay (NFC) or online anywhere Visa is accepted — crypto converts to local fiat at checkout at a 1% fee.

  5. Earn 2% cashback automatically on eligible transactions (paid in USDT), or up to 10% by holding OOB tokens.
quando usarlo:
Use Oobit when you:

  • Hold stablecoins (USDT, USDC) and want to spend them for daily purchases without converting first

  • Want the highest cashback rate in the market without locking up capital in a native token

  • Use an external wallet (MetaMask, Trust Wallet) and want to spend from it directly via DePay

  • Need a global card in 150+ countries with no annual fee or mandatory staking

Not ideal if you:

  • Need a physical card — Oobit is virtual-only

  • Need IBAN or SEPA banking features — Oobit is a payment app, not a neobank

  • Want the full 10% cashback without engaging with OOB token — the base rate is 2%

Title: Brighty
Description: Crypto-native EU banking app with IBAN, Visa card and DeFi yield vaults
Full description: Brighty is what you get when ex-Revolut builders ask "what if we made crypto banking actually crypto-native?".
Cos'è:
Brighty is the crypto banking app that does not force you to choose between fiat and crypto. Your IBAN receives salary, freelance income or SEPA transfers. Your Visa card spends BTC, ETH or USDC. Your vault earns yield on stablecoins overnight. All three work in the same app without moving money between platforms.

Think of it as a bank account that grew up in the DeFi world. The fiat rails are real (European IBAN, SEPA, Apple Pay), but the backend is built around crypto logic — instant conversion, on-chain yield, crypto-first UX.
Come funziona:
1. Download the app (iOS or Android), register and complete KYC.

  2. Receive your European IBAN — start accepting SEPA transfers immediately.

  3. Deposit crypto (BTC, ETH, USDC via ERC-20 or TRC-20) or fiat from your bank.

  4. Activate your Visa card (virtual instant, physical mailed) — link it to any account balance.

  5. Pay anywhere Visa is accepted — crypto converts to EUR at ~1% spread at checkout.

  6. Optionally open an Earning Vault to earn yield on idle USDC or ETH (up to 10% APY).
quando usarlo:
Use Brighty when you:

  • Live in Europe and want crypto + IBAN in one app without a traditional bank account

  • Receive income in crypto or stablecoins and need to spend it in daily life

  • Want to earn yield on idle USDC while keeping spending access

  • Are a digital nomad who needs flexible EUR/USD/GBP support

Not ideal if you:

  • Need high ATM withdrawal limits — fees are higher than the industry average

  • Want a globally recognized, established brand — Brighty is still growing its reputation

  • Prefer full self-custody spending — all balances are custodial on Brighty

Title: Nexo Card

Cashback is paid in BTC or NEXO token depending on user preference and tier.

  • Want cashback in crypto

Title: Gnosis Pay
Description: Self-custodial card, spend directly from your wallet.
Full description: One of the most innovative crypto cards. True self-custody spending directly from your smart wallet.
Cos'è:
Gnosis Pay is a self-custodial crypto debit card built on Gnosis Chain. Unlike centralized crypto cards, it allows users to spend directly from a smart contract wallet.

Funds remain on-chain and under user control until the moment of payment.

It is tightly integrated with the Safe (formerly Gnosis Safe) ecosystem and Web3 wallets.
Come funziona:
1. Connect or create a smart wallet

  2. Fund the wallet with supported assets

  3. Link the Visa card

  4. When paying, assets are swapped on-chain

  5. Merchant receives fiat via Visa network

The user keeps custody of funds until the transaction is executed.
quando usarlo:
Use Gnosis Pay when you:

  • Prefer self-custody

  • Use DeFi regularly

  • Want on-chain spending

  • Avoid centralized custody risk

Not ideal if you:

  • Want IBAN banking features

  • Prefer fully custodial plug-and-play

  • Don’t use Web3 wallets

Title: Kast
Description: Stablecoin-funded USD Visa card, available in the US
Full description: Stablecoin-backed Visa card that converts a USD balance from crypto deposits, with instant virtual card issuance and availability in the US.
Cos'è: Kast is a prepaid Visa card linked to a custodial USD balance funded through stablecoin or crypto deposits. Stablecoins (USDT, USDC, USDe, PYUSD, RLUSD) load at 1:1 with no fee, while volatile assets (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, BNB) are converted to USD on arrival at a 2%–5% fee. The card is available in 170+ countries, including the US, where it also provides virtual USD account numbers for ACH and FedWire transfers.
Come funziona:
1. Download the app and complete KYC (ID and selfie, no credit check).

  2. Deposit stablecoins (1:1, no fee) or volatile crypto (converted at 2%–5% fee) into the Kast balance.

  3. Receive an instant virtual Visa card; order a physical card if needed ($40 shipping on the free tier, 7–10 business days).

  4. Spend via Visa network, Apple Pay, or Google Pay — USD purchases carry 0% fee, non-USD purchases carry 0.5%–1.75% FX fee.

  5. Earn cashback in USD credited to the card balance: 1.5% on the free tier (up to $2,000/month spend), 2% on Premium ($1,000/year), or 3% on Private ($10,000/year).
quando usarlo:
Use Kast when you:

  • Hold stablecoins (USDT, USDC) and want to spend them in USD without an off-ramp

  • Are a US resident or reside in one of the 170+ supported countries

  • Want a free-tier card with no annual fee and instant virtual issuance

  • Need virtual USD account numbers for ACH/FedWire alongside card spending

Not ideal if you:

  • Mainly hold BTC or ETH — deposits are sold at a 2%–5% fee before you can spend

  • Need frequent ATM cash — withdrawals are capped at $250 each, $750/24h, plus $3 + 2% fee

  • Prefer self-custody — all balances are custodial, held by Kast

  • Need SEPA/IBAN banking — Kast offers US ACH/FedWire, not European IBAN rails

Title: Revolut
Description: Mainstream fintech crypto spending on 180+ assets
Full description: Revolut is the fintech super-app that turned "bank for the modern era" into a real product.
Cos'è:
Revolut is the Swiss army knife of digital finance: banking, crypto, stock trading and international transfers all in one app. Its Mastercard lets you spend any of your balances — fiat, crypto, or stablecoin — and the app converts automatically at checkout, prioritizing whichever asset you set first in your spending order.

Think of it as a bank account that happens to speak crypto. You never leave the app to manage your money across different platforms. If you want to go from USDC to a restaurant bill in Tokyo without touching anything, Revolut handles it.
Come funziona:
1. Sign up with email and complete KYC (required for all tiers).

  2. Choose your plan — free Standard plan gives basic crypto access; Metal and Ultra plans unlock cashback and reduced trading fees.

  3. Deposit fiat via bank transfer or card, or buy crypto directly in-app.

  4. Set your spending priority order in Settings — choose which balance the card draws from first.

  5. Pay anywhere Mastercard is accepted — crypto converts to fiat at the point of purchase.

  6. Cashback (up to 1%) is credited in the currency of your choice on eligible paid-plan transactions.
quando usarlo:
Use Revolut when you:

  • Want one app for banking, crypto and international transfers without juggling platforms

  • Travel frequently and need zero-fee foreign exchange within plan limits

  • Already have fiat in the app and want to add crypto exposure on top

  • Need a real IBAN and SEPA functionality alongside crypto spending

Not ideal if you:

  • Want meaningful cashback — it requires a paid plan (from €9.99/mo)

  • Prefer self-custody — all assets are custodial inside Revolut

  • Want a pure crypto-focused product — Revolut is primarily a neobank
